Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.

Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, results-driven Principal, Business Marketing (Search & Google Shopping) to take end-to-end ownership of our paid search engine marketing and shopping channel strategies. In this role, you will manage large budgets across the entire Google ecosystem (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and Microsoft Advertising.

The ideal candidate embodies Coupang’s Leadership Principles—acting as an owner, diving deep into auction mechanics, systematically optimizing bidding and catalog feed structures, and driving real incremental growth. You will be responsible for scaling net-new GMV, optimizing incremental Return on Ad Spend (iROAS), and working cross-functionally with Analytics, Engineering, Finance, and Category teams to maximize bottom-line profitability. An experimental mindset is essential to learn, innovate, and drive continuous growth. We believe that world-class performance marketing relies on a rigorous "test-and-learn" philosophy

Position : Principal, Business Marketing (Search advertising)

What will you do?

1. High-Precision Campaign Execution & Capital Allocation

• End-to-End Channel Ownership: Strategize, launch, scale, and optimize high-budget Google Search (RSA, DSA), Google Shopping (GSA), Performance Max (PMax), and Microsoft Advertising campaigns with a holistic view of company profitability.
• Bidding Calibration & Optimization: Build scalable processes and feedback mechanisms across all Google bidding mechanics. Apply calibration multipliers to align in-platform bids with true incremental returns.
• Laser-Focused Capital Allocation: Dynamically reallocate daily budget pools between Brand, Non-Brand Search, and Shopping feeds based on margin profiles, unit economics, and peak demand spikes. Eliminate wasteful broad-match spend.
• Zero-Defect Standards : Maintain 100% account hygiene, including tracking parameters (MMP / Google Tag / Conversion Signals), bid caps, feed updates, and negative keyword maintenance.

2. Strategic Search Expansion & Catalog Engineering

• Aggressive Market Expansion: Lead bold keyword acquisition initiatives to capture dominant market share across Taiwan without compromising efficiency floors.
• Theme Clustering & Semantic Cohesion: Leverage Dynamic Search Ads (DSA) to capture long-tail intent. Implement intent-based clustering to solve "Theme Fragmentation," ensuring ad groups remain semantically concise and aligned with Google's relevance algorithms.
• Google Merchant Center (GMC) Leadership: Oversee product feed health, title/attribute optimization, automated custom label structures and rapid disapproval resolutions. Own the Google Merchant Excellence report and benchmarks for channel dominance.

3. Advanced Analytics, "Deep Dives" & Incrementality

• Root Cause Analysis: Conduct granular daily and weekly deep dives into search term reports, auction insights, impression share metrics, and signal drift to prune broad-match leakage.
• Beyond Surface Metrics: Analyze GMV per Click (GPC), auction impression share, conversion delay models, and SKU-level performance rather than relying on surface clicks or platform-reported figures.
• Incrementality & Lift Measurement: Lead user-level Conversion Lift experiments (Ghost Ads / Holdouts) to establish true incremental ROAS (iROAS) and calibrate Smart Bidding algorithms despite channel complexities and dependencies.
• Pipeline Validation: Partner with data engineering to validate web and mobile app attribution pipelines across Google Tag, Firebase SDK, and MMPs.

4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Executive Alignment

• Data-Led Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex auction mechanics, calibration models, and incrementality data into actionable insights.
• Constructive Alignment : Challenge assumptions openly using data when evaluating campaign launches. Once a direction is set, execute with full commitment.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience: 8 to 10+ years of hands-on experience managing large-scale performance marketing budgets specifically within Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax) and SEM, ideally within E-Commerce or high-growth tech environments.
• High-Budget Track Record: Proven track record of managing large daily/monthly budgets (tens of thousands USD daily spend) in fast-paced e-commerce or marketplace environments with a strong sense of urgency.
• Technical & Bidding Mastery: Expert-level technical understanding of Google's Smart Bidding algorithms, auction-time signals, conversion delay models, and feed optimization tactics.
• Data Literacy & Deep Analytics: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets (advanced modeling). Experience with SQL, Python, or BI tools (Looker/Tableau/BigQuery) for executing technical audits and processing raw conversion logs is desired.
• MMP & Tracking Expertise: Strong technical understanding of Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations, Firebase SDK, URL tracking parameters, and web-to-app conversion pathways.
• First-Principles Problem Solving: A first-principles thinker who creates SOPs rather than just following them. Hungry for new knowledge and proactive in adopting privacy-first platform technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

• Extreme Ownership: You close every thread you start. You are responsible for the health of the account 24/7 and ensure seamless transitions and delegations during absences.
• The "Hungry" Learner: You don't settle for "I don't know." You are motivated to explore the "why" behind performance shifts and stay ahead of platform algorithm changes.
• Efficiency First: You understand that scaling is easy, but scaling profitably is an art. You focus on purifying signals rather than just buying impressions.

• Background in traditional animation or motion capture data manipulation to better bridge the gap between art and code.

jobs.description: Titre du poste: Stagiaire - Design de système - Beenox (Hiver 2027) Identifiant de demande de poste: R027943 Description du poste: Stagiaire en design de système – Beenox (Hiver 2027) * À noter que ce stage aura lieu à l’hiver 2027. Ce poste est basé dans nos bureaux de Québec et suit un mode de travail en présentiel de cinq jours par semaine. Les modalités de travail peuvent évoluer en fonction des besoins de l’entreprise. Fondé à Québec et poursuivant sa croissance avec une équipe à Montréal, Beenox possède plus de 25 ans d’expertise en développement de jeux. En tant que studio d'Activision, nous sommes leaders dans le divertissement interactif et impliqués dans la création de titres renommés. C’est avec fierté que nous contribuons grandement à la célèbre franchise Call of Duty, notamment par la création de contenu sur les saisons de Warzone et en dirigeant le développement de la version PC de Call of Duty. À travers notre histoire, nous avons également participé au succès de Crash Bandicoot, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, Skylanders, Spider-Man et Guitar Hero. Notre raison d’être est de propulser les gens à forger des relations et à vivre l’exaltation de se surpasser ensemble, jour après jour. Nous sommes déterminés.es dans notre mission d'élever des expériences de jeux emblématiques à des niveaux inégalés, pour tous les joueurs.euses. Description du rôle​ En tant que stagiaire en design de système, vous travaillerez aux côtés de nos designers d'expérience et de notre équipe de production pour concevoir, prototyper et affiner des mécaniques et des systèmes de jeu captivants. Vous aurez l'opportunité d'apporter votre pierre à l'édifice sur des projets d'envergure internationale en participant directement au processus créatif et technique.​ Responsabilités principales​ Conception de systèmes et de mécaniques : Participer à l'élaboration et à l'équilibrage des règles de jeu, des systèmes de progression, du comportement des armes/personnages ou des modes de jeu.​ Prototypage & Implémentation : Intégrer et configurer des éléments de gameplay directement dans le moteur de jeu propriétaire à l'aide d'outils internes et de scripts.​ Collaboration interdisciplinaire : Travailler étroitement avec les artistes, les programmeurs, les animateurs et les Level Designers pour assurer la cohérence visuelle et technique de la vision du jeu. Documentation : Rédiger et maintenir à jour des documents de conception (Game Design Documents - GDD) clairs, synthétiques et accessibles aux équipes de production.​ Tests & Itération : Participer activement aux sessions de playtest, analyser les retours de jeu, identifier les problèmes d'ergonomie/gameplay et proposer des solutions d'amélioration. Exigences de base ​ Formation : Étudiant(e) en Game Design, informatique, génie logiciel ou dans une discipline connexe.​ Connaissances techniques : Compréhension des principes fondamentaux de Game Design (boucles de gameplay, équilibrage, UX/UI, pacing).​ Moteurs de jeu : Expérience préalable (projets académiques ou personnels) sur un moteur de jeu (Unreal Engine, Unity ou moteur propriétaire).​ Logique & Scripting : Familiarité avec le scripting visuel (ex. Blueprints) ou un langage de programmation (C++, C#, Python, etc.).​ Compétences relationnelles : forte capacité à communiquer ses idées à l'écrit comme à l'oral, esprit d'équipe et ouverture aux critiques constructives.​ Passion : Intérêt marqué pour les jeux vidéo (notamment les jeux d'action / FPS / multijoueur) et compréhension des tendances actuelles de l'industrie.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요..

팀 소개

•

쿠팡이츠 광고 솔루션을 아직 사용하지 않은 광고주를 발굴하고 적절한 광고 상품을 제안하는 역할 수행

•

전문적인 디지털 광고 컨설팅을 통해 광고주의 비즈니스 성장을 지원하고 경쟁 시장에서의 입지를 강화

•

디지털 광고 커리어를 희망하는 인재가 기본기부터 탄탄하게 성장할 수 있는 출발점 제공

포지션 소개

•

광고주와 직접 소통하여 광고 상품을 제안하고 계약을 성사시키는 Ad Sales 역할 수행

•

아웃바운드 콜 및 대면 미팅 중심으로 영업 활동을 전개

•

광고주의 니즈에 기반한 맞춤형 광고 컨설팅 진행

주요 업무

• 신규 광고주 발굴을 위한 아웃바운드 콜 및 커뮤니케이션 활동
• 광고주의 니즈에 맞춘 맞춤형 광고 솔루션 제안 및 계약 체결
• 광고 성과 분석 및 업셀링 전략 수립·실행
•

광고주와의 장기 파트너십 구축 및 내부 협업을 통한 성공 전략 수립

자격 요건

• 풀타임 근무 가능하신 분, 지정된 입사일에 입사하실 수 있는 분
• 광고 커리어를 시작하고 싶은 분
• 스스로 높은 목표치 세우고 이를 달성하기 위해 적극적으로 액션 하시는
• 우선 순위를 스스로 설정하고 이에 대한 관리가 능숙하신 분

근무형태

쿠팡이츠 소속 계약직

(3개월 계약 후 성과 및 평가에 따라 6개월 단위의 계약 연장이 가능하며, 1년 이상 근무 시 성과 및 평가에 따라 정규직 전환 검토 기회가 부여됩니다.)

근무요일

주 5일제 (월~금), 오전 9시 30분 ~ 오후 6시 30분

근무지역

서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 332 (HJ타워) 쿠팡 로켓 연구소

급여조건

연 기준 약 3,232만원 + 매월 실적에 따른 인센티브 (금액 제한 없는 인센티브)

자주 묻는 질문

Q. 신입이나 졸업예정자도 지원이 가능한가요?

A. 네 가능합니다. 유관 경력이 없는 신입도 지원 가능하며, 대외활동이나 아르바이트 경험을 이력서에 녹여내서 작성해주시면 좋습니다. 풀타임 근무가 가능하시고 지정된 입사일에 입사가 가능하신 분 이라면 누구나 지원 가능합니다.

Q. 이력서에는 어떤 내용을 적어야 하나요?

A. 기본 인적사항을 포함하여, 누군가를 설득해본 경험, 고객을 응대한 경험을 적어주시면 좋습니다. 세일즈 경험이 없더라도 긍정적인 커뮤니케이션을 해 본 경험이 있다면 함께 적어주세요.

Q. 쿠팡이츠의 복리후생에는 어떤게 있나요?

A. 자유로운 연차 및 반차 사용이 가능하며, 건강검진과 쾌적한 사무실 환경, 자율복장으로 근무 만족도를 높이고 있습니다. 구내식당에서 조식과 석식을 무료로 제공하며, 중식은 4,500원에 이용 가능합니다. 간식과 음료도 상시 제공되며, 업무용 노트북과 쿠팡 캐시 환급 혜택도 지원됩니다. 각종 경조사 지원금 및 보험도 함께 제공되어, 직원의 삶을 폭넓게 지원하고 있습니다.

전형절차

• 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

• 고용형태는 계약직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다.
• 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류반환정책

• 본고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지
• 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. Job Details

The Patient Services Liaison will be the primary point of contact for ambulatory pharmacy access and affordability services. The work will involve routine interaction with office staff to provide patient access services, communication and guidance to ensure patients receive timely access to medication therapy. The liaison will also be responsible for establishing and maintaining strong relationships with the client and demonstrating accountability for service delivery. This role provides subject matter expertise relating to retail pharmacy access and affordability and consults directly with clinic staff and physicians to refer patients to the appropriate pharmacy based on the health system’s established process. The associate will work collaboratively with the health system client to execute established marketing and business development plans to support the increased utilization of internal health system pharmacy services. The liaison will work both independently and with other team members to facilitate benefits verification and prior authorizations services for patients.

Location: On-site role in Lodi and Clearlake, CA

Responsibilities:

•

Provide liaison services for patients requiring high-cost retail prescription therapies & infusion therapies, focused on navigation of prescription related access and affordability barriers. Effectively processing prior authorizations, identifying and securing patient assistance and routing prescriptions to the appropriate pharmacy. Coordinating the communication between patients, providers, staff, pharmacy and payers.

•

Provide subject matter expertise in retail pharmacy prescription & infusion therapy access and processing. Routinely interfacing with office staff, providers and leadership to proactively identify an address areas for process improvement to drive improved patient access and prescription internalization.

•

For the assigned clinic(s) serve as the primary contact for high cost prescription access and affordability. Responsible for maintaining effective and complete communication to stakeholders and appropriate documentation within electronic health records, pharmacy dispensing systems and other systems as specified.

•

Responsible for providing education to providers, clinic staff and patients on the value of prescription fulfillment through the client health system pharmacy. Providing world class customer service and timely execution of assigned tasks to drive trust and satisfaction with patients and providers.

•

Works with the internal client pharmacy to facilitate and coordinate delivery of the prescriptions to patients. Actively contributes to activity tracking and KPI reporting to enable continuous quality improvement and program performance assessment.

•

Participates in client and clinic meetings, contributing content and leading discussions relating to prescription access as needed.

•

Support the clinic during operating hours and work extended hours when needed to ensure patients receive their medication and to complete business plan objectives. Provide backup coverage to support clients and patients in the event of absence of other assigned resources.

•

Work both in clinic (or multiple clinics as assigned) and support from an approved remote location as the client needs dictate. Demonstrate the ability to provide a high level of support from both settings

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Education:

•

Retail pharmacy technician experience 1-3 years

•

Active pharmacy technician licensure / certification in the corresponding state

Skills and Knowledge:

•

Experience working with prior authorizations and copay assistance programs

•

Lead tech or other leadership experience a plus (not required)

•

Proficiency in Microsoft Office particularly Word and Excel

•

Ability to quickly learn other systems and programs (pharmacy dispensing software, electronic health records, etc.)

•

High level of organization and high quality communication skills

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community Join Humana Gold Plus Integrated as a Care Coordinator and make a meaningful impact on the lives of Illinois Medicaid Members. As a Care Coordinator supporting Humana's Illinois HealthChoice Medicaid Managed Care program, you will play a vital role in helping members achieve their best possible health and well-being. Reporting to the Manager, Care Management, you will assess member's unique needs, develop personalized care plans, and connect individuals and families with the resources and support they need to thrive. If you are passionate about helping others navigate their healthcare journey and creating lasting change, we encourage you to apply. Upon hire, you will be assigned to support either MLTSS or LTSS based on business needs. This position will support members within the catchment 13 area which includes the following IL counties: Mason, Logan, Menard, Cass, Scott, Morgan, Sangamon, and Christian The Care Coordinator responsibilities are as follows: Visit Medicaid members in their homes, Assisted Living Facilities, and/or Long-Term Care Facilities and other care settings – 75%-90% local travel. Ensure members are receiving services in the least restrictive setting to achieve and/or maintain optimal well-being by assessing their care needs. Identify and resolve barriers that hinder effective care. Plan and implement interventions to meet care needs. Coordinate services, monitor, and evaluate the case management plan against the member's personal goals. Ensure the patient is progressing towards desired outcomes by continuously monitoring patient care through use of assessment, data, conversations with members, and active care planning. Assess and evaluate enrollee's needs via telephonic and face to face assessments and evaluations, to coordinate services and address enrollee needs. Assist enrollee to remediate immediate and acute gaps in care and access. Assist enrollee with filing grievances and appeals. Provide information to enrollee related to MCO requirements, services, and benefits. Provide enrollee with information and/or referrals to community resources. Guide members/families towards resources appropriate for their care. Services are driven by facilitating interactions with other payer sources, providers, interdisciplinary teams, and others involved in the member's care as appropriate and required by our comprehensive contract. Use your skills to make an impact Required Qualifications The Care Coordinator must meet one (1) of the following requirements: Bachelor's degree in social sciences, social work, human services, or a related field. Unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) in the state of Illinois with one (1) year experience conducting comprehensive assessments and provision of formal service for the elderly. Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC). Licensed Social Worker (LSW). The Care Coordinator must meet all following requirements: Must reside in the state of Illinois. 1+ years of experience in health care and/or case management. 1+ years of experience with Medicare & Medicaid recipients and/or long-term care and/or Home and Community based services and/or working with managed care organizations. Intermediate to advanced computer skills and experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Experience using a variety of electronic information applications/software programs including electronic medical records. Additional Information Workstyle/Travel: This is a Field position that requires 75 - 90% travel in the field to visit members. Schedule: Monday - Friday 8am - 5pm CST but open to flexible work schedule. Possibility of working additional hours based on business needs. Driving This role is part of Humana's driver safety program and therefore requires an individual to have a valid state driver's license and are expected to maintain personal vehicle liability insurance. Individual must carry vehicle insurance in accordance with their residing state minimum required limits, or $25,000 bodily injury per person/$25,000 bodily injury per event /$10,000 for property damage or whichever is higher. TB This role is considered patient facing and is part of Humana's Tuberculosis (TB) screening program. If selected for this role, you will be required to be screened for TB. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Pay Range The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. Mobile Threat Landscape and Strategy
